  C)   Do you agree that alpha-beta pruning is better over min-max strategy? Justify.                 (4)  
  4)        The Wumpus world is a cave with 16 rooms (4×4). Each room is connected to others  
  through walkways (no rooms are connected diagonally). The knowledge-based agent  
  starts from Room [1, 1]. The cave has - some pits, a treasure and a beast named  
  A)   Wumpus. The Wumpus cannot move but eats the one who enters its room. If the agent  
  enters the pit, it gets stuck there. The goal of the agent is to take the treasure and come    (3)  
  out of the cave. The agent is rewarded when the goal conditions are met. The agent is  
  penalized when it falls into a pit or being eaten by the Wumpus. Apply the PEAS  
  specification for the wumpus world.  
  
  B)   Define is resolution? Provide resolution for the following statements in Wumpus world.  
  i)There is a pit at 2,1 or 2,3 or 1,2 or 3,2.                                          (3)  
  ii)Therefore (by resolution) the pit must be at 2,3 or 1,2 or 3,2
